Posting of Agenda. Pursuant to NRS 241.020(4), the agenda for the Nevada Tahoe Conservation District Board of Supervisors has been posted at the Nevada Tahoe
Conservation District Office (400 Dorla Ct., Zephyr Cove, NV 89448) and has been electronically posted at https://notice.nv.gov and https://ntcd.org.
How to Get Copies of Agenda and Supporting Materials. Copies of this agenda and supporting materials for the items on the agenda may be obtained by contacting Dana
Olson (400 Dorla Ct., Zephyr Cove, NV. 89448, phone 775-586-1610, or e-mail dolson@ntcd.org). The agenda and supporting materials may also be accessed on the Nevada
Tahoe Conservation District website at https://ntcd.org/board-of-supervisors/. A person requesting material may receive it by email or a physical copy at no charge. Supporting
materials are available to the public at the same time they are available to the Board of Supervisors. If materials are distributed at a meeting, they will be available within one
business day.
Possible Changes to Agenda and Timing. The Board of Supervisors may consider items on the agenda out of order, may combine two or more agenda items for consideration,
may remove an item from the agenda, or may delay discussion of an item on the agenda at any time. Items with a specific time designation will not be heard prior to the stated
time, but may be heard later. Items listed in the Consent section of the agenda are considered and voted on as a block and will not be read aloud or considered separately unless
requested by a Supervisor.
Public Comment. Public comments are welcome during the Public Comment periods at the beginning and end of the meeting for all matters, whether listed on the agenda or
not. Additionally, public comment specific to the action item will be heard during individual action items on the agenda. Public comments are limited to three (3) minutes per
person per comment period. Persons may not allocate unused time to other speakers.
Members of the public may submit public comment via Teams, by logging into the webinar using the link at the top of the agenda, or by typing https://www.microsoft.com/en-
us/microsoft-teams/join-a-meeting in your computer browser, and entering Meeting ID 282 575 014 771 and Passcode MXcwsN. This option will require a computer with audio
and video capabilities. To provide public comment via Teams, please use the “Raise Hand” feature during any public comment period. To join by telephone, please call 1-929-
346-7276 and enter passcode 271 736 605 and pressing #. To provide public comment via telephone, press *5 to raise your hand during any public comment period, and *6 to
mute or unmute your phone.
Additionally, persons are invited to submit public comments in writing by emailing Dana Olson at dolson@ntcd.org. The Nevada Tahoe Conservation District will make
reasonable efforts to include all such comments received by 4:00 p.m. one working day prior to the meeting in the record.
Forum Restrictions and Orderly Conduct of Business. The Board of Supervisors conducts the business of the Nevada Tahoe Conservation District during its meetings. The
presiding officer may order the removal of any person whose statement or other conduct disrupts the orderly, efficient, or safe conduct of the meeting. Warnings against
disruptive comments or behavior may or may not be given prior to removal. The viewpoint of a speaker will not be restricted, but reasonable restrictions may be imposed upon
the time, place, and manner of speech. Irrelevant and unduly repetitious statements and personal attacks that antagonize or incite others are examples of speech that may be
reasonably limited.
Responses to Public Comments. The Board of Supervisors can deliberate or take action only if a matter has been listed on an agenda properly posted prior to the meeting. The
Open Meeting Law does not expressly prohibit responses to public comments by the Board of Supervisors. However, responses from Supervisors to unlisted public comment
topics could become deliberation on a matter without notice to the public. To avoid this situation and to ensure the public has notice of all matters the Board of Supervisors will
consider, Supervisors may choose not to respond to public comments, except to correct factual inaccuracies or to ask that a matter be listed on a future Nevada Tahoe
Conservation District meeting agenda. The Nevada Tahoe Conservation District may do this either during the Public Comment item or during the following item: “Supervisor’s
Comments [Non-action item].”
Special Accommodations. Any person requiring accommodation to participate in this public meeting may contact Dana Olson by emailing dolson@ntcd.org or by calling 775-
586-1610 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.

Consent Calendar
The consent calendar consists of item 5 below. Items appearing on the Consent Calendar are items that can be adopted with
one motion unless pulled by a Supervisor or a member of the public. Members of the public who wish to have a consent item
   placed on the Administrative Agenda shall make that request during the public comment section at the beginning of the
      meeting and specifically state why they are making the request. When items are pulled for discussion, they will be
       automatically placed at the beginning of the Administrative Agenda or may be continued until another meeting.

                  Passage Project Agreement for $32,031 with the Nevada Department of Wildlife
                  This is additional funding for the Lower Rosewood Creek Aquatic Organism Passage
            G     Project to remove two metal standpipe culvert crossings installed in 2003 along lower               74
